summary: Move-learning resolver stalled on a wrapped acknowledgement
symptom: Ohmnomnom's level-12 Fake Out prompt timed out before the forget screen

unexpected.predicted: The resolver advances all verified move-learning pages and reaches field mode 33
unexpected.actual: It stopped on 'already\nknows four moves' until the frame budget expired
diff: raw text matching did not treat a printer line break as whitespace

authority.oracle: Field printer RAM, field message-box mode, and decrypted party move tuples

reproduction.command: disposable_clone fixture; level Ohmnomnom to 12; resolve Fake Out into slot 0
reproduction.observed: Before normalization the resolver deterministically timed out; after normalization two complete level-17 replays returned clean overworld

hypotheses.claim: Printer line wrapping alone prevents the acknowledgement marker from matching
hypotheses.predicted_discriminator: Whitespace-normalized pages advance while preserving all existing ownership checks
hypotheses.evidence_for: Manual A trace advanced the same page; normalization produced two exact successful replays

root_cause.claim: Move-learning ownership checks compared phrases against raw wrapped printer text
evidence: normalized shared decoder passed two replays
alternatives_falsified: Timing delay: the page remained stable across repeated 30-frame waits
Wrong prompt: mode and following pages matched the standard four-move flow

solution.contract_change: Move-learning page classification normalizes whitespace before all phrase matching
